data.name: Naushabah
data.gender_notes: Naushabah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-h', meaning 'to breathe, to live'. In Islamic tradition, Naushabah is a name for a gentle and delicate girl, radiating peace and tranquility. The name Naushabah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naushabah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the gentle breath of life, reminding us of the importance of nurturing and cherishing the gift of existence.
data.etymology: Naushabah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naushabah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
